## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
Sector Rotation, not Risk-Off. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); Style: Value/Cyclical tilt.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Financials lead: COF (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND, USB (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +17.03%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: TSLA (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +14.27%) ABOVE TREND, GM (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +18.79%) CORRECTION. Materials solid: FCX (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +19.55%) CORRECTION, NEM (1W: +0.03% | 1M: +15.17%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities lag: EXC (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -4.66%) RECOVERY, DUK (1W: +2.66% | 1M: -5.15%) RECOVERY. Energy weak: VLO (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -11.59%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -1.78% | 1M: -1.36%) BELOW TREND. Communication under pressure: NFLX (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -16.92%) RECOVERY, T (1W: +0.25% | 1M: -4.84%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EL (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +20.03%) CORRECTION, COF (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +19.55%) CORRECTION, GM (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +18.79%) CORRECTION, USB (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +17.03%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: EXC (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -4.66%) RECOVERY, T (1W: +0.25% | 1M: -4.84%) RECOVERY, DUK (1W: +2.66% | 1M: -5.15%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: -5.52% | 1M: -5.74%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: +2.07% | 1M: -5.97%) RECOVERY — weakness concentrated in large-cap tech and select utilities.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: TSLA (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +14.27%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +2.80% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND, DUK (1W: +2.66% | 1M: -5.15%) RECOVERY. Major divergence present — AAPL (1W: -2.23% | 1M: +1.65%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -5.03% | 1M: +4.44%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -0.41% | 1M: +8.76%) CORRECTION — watch for trend breaks; treat moves as tactical.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with downside in marquee names; Tech: 11/19 positive. NVDA (1W: -5.52% | 1M: -5.74%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -13.97%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -10.25% | 1M: -19.06%) BELOW TREND while ACN (1W: +1.25% | 1M: +14.06%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: -5.03% | 1M: +4.44%) CORRECTION.

8. Financials Outlook?
Clear strength; Financials: 16/20 positive. COF (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND, USB (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +17.03%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +5.20%) CORRECTION — breadth supports cyclicals and bank exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Flattening rotation; Healthcare: 10/15 positive. JNJ (1W: +0.15% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: +1.14%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and cyclicals (COF (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND, USB (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +17.03%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +14.27%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to marquee tech under pressure (NVDA (1W: -5.52% | 1M: -5.74%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -13.97%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -10.25% | 1M: -19.06%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt, but major divergence warrants tactical sizing.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: COF (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +14.27%) ABOVE TREND, ACN (1W: +1.25% | 1M: +14.06%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -5.52% | 1M: -5.74%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -13.97%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -10.25% | 1M: -19.06%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Financials (16/20 positive) and Materials (strong 1M leaders). BEARISH: Utilities (1/6 positive) and Energy (2/8 positive) and Communication (2/7 positive) as they show relative weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for continued weekly closes below its 1M lows to confirm BELOW TREND pressure. Monitor AAPL (1W: -2.23% | 1M: +1.65%) CORRECTION for a 1W reversal as trigger for tech stabilization. JPM (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +5.20%) CORRECTION — breakout above recent 1M highs would signal Financials momentum continuation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Rotation with a Value/Cyclical tilt; Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. COF (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND, USB (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +17.03%) ABOVE TREND and TSLA (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +14.27%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Major divergence among big tech (AAPL, GOOGL, META, NVDA) is the key risk—watch for trend breaks and treat moves as tactical.
